The '''Jasserak Highlands''' was a plateau located on [[Tanlassa]] continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] near the [[Qarohan Steppes]] that formed the border of the [[Jasserak Lowlands]]. The plateau was filled with a strange type of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]]-like [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that produced [[avedame fruit]].
